evidence: Pure terminal, decoder, and SPSC queue behavior is supported by independently observed strict builds/tests and by the reviewer-authored model/concurrency harness.
The reference links as ELF32/i386 ET_EXEC with entry 0x101000, an aligned valid Multiboot-v1 header at file offset 4096, no relocations, and no undefined symbols.

The produced IRQ path contains compiler-generated SSE2 moves through xmm0, while the boot code does not establish SSE state and the ISR saves only general registers; the Makefile leaves the CPU/soft-float baseline to host GCC defaults.

The reference ELF's .bss has VMA 0x103000 but LMA and PT_LOAD physical address 0x1057c0, inconsistent with the flat physical-equals-virtual execution model; the supplied verifier does not inspect program headers.

MANIFEST.yaml names 14e4683c... as provenance_sha256, but delivered PROVENANCE.json hashes to 91899132... as raw bytes and d904f811... canonically; the manifest therefore does not directly authenticate the delivered provenance representation.

Reference ELFs built from identical source and object bytes at two build paths differed as complete files because an object path is retained in the symbol table; their loadable .text bytes were identical.
The challenge has a clear numbered contract, genuine starter failures, useful public feedback, concepts/questions/debugging exercises, and solution-bearing material separated under sealed/.
Validation language is appropriately restrained: the manifest remains GENERATED/PARTIAL, productionized is false, and no boot, fuzzing, benchmark, transfer, security, or production label is claimed.
limitations: qemu-system-i386, grub-file, grub-mkrescue, and xorriso are unavailable, so no boot, keyboard IRQ, or screen behavior was observed.
AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer targets could not link because libasan.so.5 and libubsan.so.1 are absent.
clang, scan-build, cppcheck, and valgrind are unavailable; no second compiler or external static/dynamic analyzer result exists.

git is unavailable and the recorded source repository/upstream article are outside the review workspace, so source_commit, catalog snapshot, no-copy, and linked-resource license claims could not be independently verified.

Host tests cannot establish privileged I/O, real interrupt timing, bootloader compatibility, physical hardware behavior, performance, security, portability, transfer readiness, or production readiness.
sealed/ is separated by convention inside the submitted tree; whether it is excluded from an actual learner view depends on the external harness and was not testable here.
